How does it work?

Each part of an IPv4 address is a number from 0 to 255. Combine the four parts in base 256 to get one decimal integer.

192 × 256³ + 168 × 256² + 1 × 256 + 1 = 3232235777

Include http:// when pasting the number into your browser. It may display the address with dots again. A different notation doesn’t change what’s running at that address.
